s.0: Shows when this product is part of a mix & match bundle. Needs the Bundle tray app embed on. Words and look: CRO Toolbox → Bundles → Style.
s.1: Which of the styles made in the app to show.
s.2: Steps, products and the look are set in CRO Toolbox → Bundles. Shoppers pay the bundle product's price, and each picked item's stock goes down.
s.3: Lets shoppers build your mix & match bundles anywhere: Add to bundle on product pages, + buttons on collection pages and a tray that follows them. Set it up in the app: Offers → Bundles.
s.4: Shows cross sell rules that have "Cart drawer" ticked, inside your theme's slide-out cart. Works with Dawn and themes built on it. Heading, products and button are set in CRO Toolbox → Offers → Cross sell offers → Style.
s.5: Products, headline and discount come from your cross sell rules; the look is set in CRO Toolbox → Offers → Cross sell offers → Style.
s.6: Offers come from your Upsell rules in CRO Toolbox; their look and wording are set in the app: Offers → Upsell → Style.
s.7: Videos, their order and linked products, the look and the pages it shows on are all set in CRO Toolbox → Video carousel.
s.8: Place it under the Add to cart button. Add-ons, texts and colours are set in the app: Offers → Add-ons.
s.9: Messages, icons, dates and the look are set in the app: Section library → Announcement bar.
s.15: Content, colours and layout are set in the app: Section library.
s.16: Goal, messages, colours and where it shows are set in the app: Section library → Free shipping bar.
s.a: Sticky add to cart, stock urgency, trust badges, sales pop-ups and bundle deals. Edit them in the app: Storefront and Offers.
s.b: Add it to the cart page. Words, dates and look are set in the app: Section library → Gift note & delivery date.
s.c: Collections, order, colours and sizes are set in the app: Section library → Collection pills.
s.d: Which of the countdown's designs made in the app to show.
s.e: Place it in the Header or Footer area, on the home page, on product pages or on the cart page. Each place has its own design, set in the app: Section library → Countdown timers.
s.f: Images, texts, sizes and arrows are set in the app: Section library → Image carousel 2.
s.g: Put it inside the product information (under the price or Add to cart) or on the cart page. Dates and words are set in the app: Section library → Delivery estimate.
s.h: Questions and the look are set in the app: Section library → FAQ. Here you only choose what this copy shows.
s.j: Optional, e.g. Shipping. Empty = all questions.
s.l: Optional. Empty = the heading set in the app.
s.m: Help Google show these questions in search
s.n: Adds FAQ structured data. Use it on one page only.
s.o: Keep it in the Header area. Layout, logo, menu, icons, colours and glass effects are set in the app: Section library → Header. The menu comes from Online Store → Navigation.
s.p: Images, texts, sizes and arrows are set in the app: Section library → Image carousel.
s.q: Logos, their order and the look are set in the app: Section library → Scrolling logos and text.
s.s: Put it once in the page template. With Page set to Automatic it shows the Track order or Returns content on the pages the app made (CRO Toolbox, Tracking & Returns), and nothing on other pages. Words and look: Tracking & Returns, Style.
s.t: Put it inside the product information, above the Add to cart button. Fields, preview and fee are set in the app: Offers → Personalization.
s.u: This product's reviews. Reviews and how they look are set in the app: Section library → Product page reviews.
s.v: Adds a button to every product card; products with sizes or colours open a small picker. The look is set in the app: Section library → Quick add to cart.
s.w: Questions, answers and the products they lead to are set in the app: Section library → Product quiz.
s.x: Reviews and how they look are set in the app: Section library → Customer reviews.
s.1b: Put it inside the product information. The charts, texts and look are set in the app: Section library → Size guide.
s.1c: Put it inside the product information, under the Add to cart button. Words and look are set in the app: Section library → Back in stock & pre-order.
